full_translation_en:
Parliament Secretariat
Federal Parliament
Kathmandu
Singha Durbar
Urgent Notice Regarding the Convening of the Session of the Federal Parliament

His Excellency the Right Honourable Ram Chandra Paudel, President of Nepal, has convened the session of the Federal Parliament in accordance with Article 93, Sub-article (1) of the Constitution of Nepal, at 2:00 PM on Monday, Baishakh 28, 2081 BS. Therefore, I hereby convene the session of the House of Representatives.

Details:

Place: House of Representatives Hall (Multipurpose Hall), Federal Parliament Building, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

Date: Monday, Baishakh 28, 2081 BS.

Time: 2:00 PM.

(Signed)

Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
Federal Parliament Secretariat
Federal Parliament

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: An urgent notice is issued by the Parliament Secretariat regarding the convening of the Federal Parliament session. The President of Nepal, Ram Chandra Paudel, has convened the session as per the constitution.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The notice specifies the date, time, and location for the upcoming session of the House of Representatives. The session is scheduled for Monday, Baishakh 28, 2081 BS, at 2:00 PM in the House of Representatives Hall.

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The notice is signed by Prasad Pandey, Secretary-General of the Federal Parliament Secretariat, formally announcing the convening of the session.
